theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_dsp_testForm_comp_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∃ φ' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, ∀ y : Euclid P, (φ' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) y = (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) (dilation a lam y)
